issues.explanation: The adaptation says Cao Cao sends Xu Huang and Wang Ping “from 斜谷” to attack the Han River, but Source Chapter 71 places Cao Cao’s army north of Dingjun Mountain and has Xu Huang and Wang Ping advance from there. 斜谷 is only reached later, after Cao Cao’s defeats and retreat in Chapter 72, so this prematurely relocates the army and conflicts with the later timeline.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace “从斜谷进攻汉水” with wording consistent with the source, such as “曹操驻军定军山北，命徐晃、王平率军进至汉水迎战”.
